- Right-click on selected stream(s) in Edit Mode shows context menu
- 'Create channel(s) in group' - Opens submenu with existing channel groups to select
- 'Create channel(s) in new group' - Opens bulk create modal with 'new group' option pre-selected
- Clicking unselected stream while right-clicking selects only that stream
- Menu closes on Escape key or click outside
- Follows existing ChannelsPane context menu patterns

Files modified:
- frontend/src/components/StreamsPane.tsx - Added context menu state, handlers, event binding, and JSX
- frontend/src/components/StreamsPane.css - Added context menu and submenu styles

title: Add context menu to group header for bulk operations
description: Extended context menu functionality to group headers. When channels in a group are selected (using the group checkbox), right-clicking on the group header now shows the same context menu options: 'Move channels to...' and 'Create new group and move'. The context menu only shows selected channels from that specific group. Changes: Added onContextMenu prop to DroppableGroupHeaderProps, added handleGroupContextMenu function that filters selected channels by group, passes the handler when rendering DroppableGroupHeader.

title: Fix create group modal to use natural sort
description: Fixed the cross-group move modal to display channels in natural sorted order by name. When using the context menu to move channels (either 'Move channels to...' or 'Create new group and move'), the list of channels shown in the modal is now sorted naturally (e.g., 'Channel 1', 'Channel 2', 'Channel 10' instead of 'Channel 1', 'Channel 10', 'Channel 2'). Changes: ChannelsPane.tsx - Added natural sort to channelsToMove array in both handleMoveToGroup and handleCreateGroup functions.

title: Filter context menu to show only visible groups
description: Modified context menu 'Move channels to...' submenu to only show groups that are currently visible in the channel list (i.e., selected in the group filter). This prevents moving channels to groups that aren't currently being displayed. The Uncategorized group is always shown since it's always visible at the top. Change: ChannelsPane.tsx line 4984 - filtered channelGroups array to only include groups in selectedGroups.

title: Add right-click context menu for channel bulk operations
description: Added right-click context menu for bulk channel operations in edit mode. When channels are selected, users can right-click to: 1) Move channels to an existing group (shows submenu of all available groups including Uncategorized), or 2) Create a new group and move the selected channels to it. The context menu only appears in edit mode when channels are selected. It integrates with the existing cross-group move modal for channel number assignment options. Files modified: ChannelsPane.tsx (added context menu state, handlers, and UI), ChannelsPane.css (added context menu styling), README.md (documented new feature).

title: Fix channel selection persisting after exiting edit mode
description: Fixed bug where selected channels remained highlighted after exiting edit mode. When switching tabs or manually exiting edit mode, the channel selection state is now properly cleared. Modified App.tsx to call setSelectedChannelIds(new Set()) in three places: handleExitEditMode (when exiting with no pending changes), handleTabChange (when switching away from Channel Manager), and handleDiscardChanges (when discarding staged changes).

title: Add descriptive subtext to Uncategorized group header
description: Added descriptive subtext to the 'Uncategorized' group header to clarify its purpose. The subtext reads '– Channels without a specific group' and is styled in a muted, italic font to be subtle and non-intrusive. This helps users understand that this group is for channels they don't want organized into separate groups. Files modified: ChannelsPane.tsx (added subtext rendering), ChannelsPane.css (added .group-subtext styling).

title: Always show Uncategorized group at top for drag-drop target
description: Modified ChannelsPane.tsx to always render the 'Uncategorized' group at the top of the channels list, even when empty. This provides a consistent drop target for users to drag channels out of groups. Previously, the Uncategorized section only appeared when it contained channels, making it impossible to ungroup channels by dragging when all channels were grouped.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Added 'Normalize Channel Names' feature to standardize channel names with league prefixes (e.g., '700 | NFL ARIZONA CARDINALS' → '700 | NFL: Arizona Cardinals'). 

Implementation:
- Added normalizeChannelDisplayName() and toTitleCase() utility functions to epgMatching.ts
- Created NormalizeNamesModal component with preview of all name changes
- Added 'Normalize' button to channel selection toolbar (appears in Edit Mode when channels are selected)
- Changes are batched for single-action undo
- Fixed natural sort order in modal preview (v0.6.10011)

Files created:
- frontend/src/components/NormalizeNamesModal.tsx
- frontend/src/components/NormalizeNamesModal.css

Files modified:
- frontend/src/utils/epgMatching.ts
- frontend/src/components/ChannelsPane.tsx
- frontend/src/components/ChannelsPane.css

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed EPG matching for league team channels. Added league match scoring to confidence calculation - now EPG entries with matching league suffix (e.g., arizonacardinals.nfl matching NFL: Arizona Cardinals) get full 40 points like country matches. Previously league matches scored only 20 points (partial credit for no country), resulting in 45% confidence instead of 85%.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added channel number range display to channel group headers in Channel Manager. Shows min-max range like '#100–150' or '#100' for single channel. Modified DroppableGroupHeader component to accept channelRange prop, calculate range from groupChannels, and display with .group-range CSS class.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed missing spacing between checkboxes and text labels in Channel Profiles section of Settings tab. Added margin-right: 0.5rem to checkbox input and margin-left: 0.25rem to profile-checkbox-label in SettingsTab.css.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Add suffix removal feature similar to network prefix stripping. This will allow users to configure custom suffixes to strip from stream names during bulk channel creation. Similar to prefix stripping which removes things like 'CHAMP |', this will remove trailing suffixes like '(HD)', '[1080p]', etc.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Updated README with TV Guide section, Dummy EPG sources documentation, and EPG API endpoints.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Released v0.6.0 with TV Guide tab, Dummy EPG sources, Auto-sync improvements, and various bug fixes. Merged dev to main and created GitHub release.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added a channel profile dropdown to the Guide tab controls. When a profile is selected, only channels in that profile are shown in the guide. The dropdown only appears if channel profiles exist. Default is 'All Channels' which shows all channels.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Changed the now-playing highlight in Guide tab from green (#4caf50) to use the UI's accent colors (--accent-primary, --accent-hover). This makes the highlight consistent with the rest of the UI and automatically adapts to different themes (dark, light, high-contrast).

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed timezone bug causing now-playing highlight to fail. The issue was using toISOString().split('T')[0] to get today's date, which returns the UTC date (e.g., Jan 8 at 1AM UTC when it's Jan 7 at 7PM local). This caused the guide to show programs for the wrong day. Added getLocalDateString() helper that uses getFullYear/getMonth/getDate to get the correct local date.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed now-playing highlight not working. The issue was that isNowPlaying used useCallback with empty deps, so the current time was calculated once at render and never updated. Added currentTime state that updates every minute via setInterval, and updated isNowPlaying and nowIndicatorPosition to depend on it.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Enhanced the now-playing show highlight in the Guide tab to be more prominent. Changed from subtle purple accent to green with glow effect for better visibility.

title: Guide tab click to edit channel
description: Added ability to click on a channel in the Guide tab to navigate to the Channel Manager tab with that channel selected. Clicking a channel row highlights it and switches tabs automatically. Also switched EPG data source from /api/epg/grid/ to /api/epg/programs/ which returns all programs without time filtering.

title: Guide tab EPG data limited range
description: Investigated EPG data stopping at 7 PM. Dispatcharr's /api/epg/grid/ endpoint returns a fixed time range (previous hour + next 24 hours from server time) and doesn't accept custom date parameters. If data stops early, it's likely due to limited EPG data in Dispatcharr itself or timezone differences. Added optional start/end params to backend (for future use if Dispatcharr adds support) but reverted frontend to simple call since params aren't honored.

title: Guide tab current time indicator
description: Added a red vertical line that shows the current time position on the Guide tab timeline. The line spans the full height of the guide grid and has a small circle marker at the top. Only visible when viewing today and current time is within the visible time range.

title: Guide tab 12-hour time format
description: Changed Start hour dropdown in Guide tab from 24-hour format to 12-hour format with AM/PM to match the timeline header display.

title: Fix Guide tab channel ordering
description: Fixed Guide tab to display channels in channel number order instead of grouping by channel_group_id (which caused random-appearing order). Removed channel group dependencies from GuideTab component.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Add a new Guide tab to Enhanced Channel Manager that displays a horizontal timeline grid view of all channels and their EPG program data. Features: horizontal scrollable timeline with 30-min time slots, sticky channel column on left, sticky time header, program blocks positioned by time, flag channels without EPG data.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Add 'Show only auto-sync' filter checkbox to Manage Groups modal, similar to the existing 'Hide disabled' checkbox.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Show auto-sync group count alongside total group count in M3U accounts list to help understand differences between M3U sources.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fix logo dropdown in AutoSyncSettingsModal to use a 3-column grid with appropriately sized logo boxes, searchable and scrollable.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fix channel sort order options in AutoSyncSettingsModal. Options should be: Provider Order (Default), Name, TVG ID, Updated At, with a separate Reverse sort order checkbox.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Prevent auto-channel groups from being synced between M3U sources. When syncing M3Us, if a group is an auto-sync group from a different source, we should not sync it as this causes duplicate channels to be created.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Add ability to create a new channel group directly from the Override Channel Group dropdown in Auto-Sync Settings Modal

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Four improvements to Auto-Sync Settings Modal: 1) Include Dummy EPG sources in Force EPG dropdown, 2) Make Override Channel Group a searchable dropdown, 3) Add 'Provider default' option to Channel Sort Order, 4) Fix Custom Logo field to show logos and support upload/URL input

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: When moving a channel to a new group with a manual channel number, if that number already exists in the target group, the app allows duplicates. Need to detect conflicts and prompt the user to choose: shift existing channels down, swap numbers, or pick a different number.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: The DummyEPGSourceModal has a <form> element between the flex container (.dummy-epg-modal) and the flex children (.modal-body, .modal-footer). This breaks the flex layout causing the modal body not to scroll properly - instead, the page behind scrolls. Fix by making the form element a flex container too.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Fixed scroll issues in EPG Manager:
- EPGManagerTab: Added min-height: 0, overflow-y: auto, flex-shrink: 0 to allow proper page scrolling
- DummyEPGSourceModal: Fixed modal body scroll by adding min-height: 0, overflow: hidden on container, flex-shrink: 0 on header/footer

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Added Dummy EPG source management feature to EPG Manager tab:

- Created DummyEPGCustomProperties type in types/index.ts with all configuration fields
- Updated CreateEPGSourceRequest in api.ts to include custom_properties
- Created DummyEPGSourceModal.tsx with full form for configuring dummy EPG sources:
  - Pattern Configuration (name source, title/time/date patterns)
  - Output Templates (title, description)
  - Collapsible sections for: Upcoming/Ended Templates, Fallback Templates, Logo/Poster URLs, EPG Tags
  - Live preview that tests regex patterns against sample channel names
  - Regex validation on blur
- Created DummyEPGSourceModal.css with matching styles
- Enhanced EPGManagerTab.tsx:
  - Added Dummy EPG Sources section below standard EPG sources
  - Dummy sources are separated from standard sources and displayed in their own list
  - Add/Edit/Delete/Toggle functionality for dummy sources
  - Dummy sources don't have refresh button (they generate on-the-fly)
- Updated EPGManagerTab.css with dummy section styles

title: Auto-sync group settings modal
description:
Added new modal for configuring advanced auto-sync settings for M3U account groups. Opens when clicking settings/gear icon on group row in M3UGroupsModal.

Features implemented:
- Force EPG Source dropdown
- Override Channel Group dropdown  
- Channel Name Find & Replace (regex pattern and replacement)
- Channel Name Filter (regex)
- Channel Profile Assignment (multi-select dropdown)
- Channel Sort Order dropdown
- Stream Profile Assignment dropdown
- Custom Logo search/select with preview

Files created:
- frontend/src/components/AutoSyncSettingsModal.tsx
- frontend/src/components/AutoSyncSettingsModal.css

Files modified:
- frontend/src/types/index.ts - Added AutoSyncCustomProperties interface
- frontend/src/components/M3UGroupsModal.tsx - Added settings column and modal integration
- frontend/src/components/M3UGroupsModal.css - Updated grid layout for new column
- frontend/src/components/tabs/M3UManagerTab.tsx - Added props for data sources
- frontend/src/App.tsx - Pass data sources to M3UManagerTab

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added onSourcesChange callback to EPGManagerTab so that when EPG sources are added or deleted, the main App.tsx state is refreshed. This ensures the EPG source list in search dropdowns is updated without requiring a page refresh.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added warning messages when user tries to add a network prefix that already exists in the built-in list or their custom list. Now shows helpful feedback like 'NFL is already a built-in prefix' instead of silently failing.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added validation to prevent adding network prefixes that already exist in the built-in NETWORK_PREFIXES list. The Add button is now disabled and the prefix won't be added if it matches a built-in prefix.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added custom network prefixes setting to allow users to define their own prefixes to strip during bulk channel creation. These merge with the built-in NETWORK_PREFIXES list. UI added in Settings > Channel Defaults page with text input for adding prefixes and tag list with delete buttons.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Added a progress bar to the Edit Mode exit dialog when applying changes. The progress bar shows:
- Current operation count / total operations
- Percentage complete
- Description of the current operation being applied
The dialog header changes to 'Applying Changes' during commit, and action buttons are hidden until commit completes.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added expand all/collapse all buttons to the Channels pane. The buttons are now placed on the same line as the search input, to the right of the search box. They allow users to quickly expand or collapse all visible channel groups.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Removed unused code and dead imports: 
- backend/main.py: Removed unused sys and traceback imports
- backend/dispatcharr_client.py: Removed unused get_stream_profile() function
- frontend/src/types/index.ts: Removed 3 unused types (BulkChannelCreateRequest, ChannelWithStreams, ChannelGroupWithChannels)
- frontend/src/utils/epgMatching.ts: Removed 2 unused sync functions (findEPGMatches, batchFindEPGMatches)

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed bug where bulk delete dialog incorrectly offered to delete a group as 'empty' when search filter was active. When user searches for channels (e.g., 'Extra'), only matching channels are visible, but the empty group check was comparing against all channels in the group, not accounting for the fact that user can only select visible channels. Fix: Skip the 'empty group' check entirely when a search term is active, since it's impossible to select all channels in a group when some are hidden by the filter.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Bug: When search filter is active in channels pane and user selects all channels in a group then tries to delete, the dialog incorrectly offers to delete the 'empty' group. Fixed by using localChannels (edit mode's working copy) instead of channels prop in the bulk delete confirmation check.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: The search field in the channels pane wasn't filtering channels. The visibleChannels filter only checked auto-created status but never applied the searchTerm. Added search filtering to match channel names and numbers.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed the auto-match EPG editor card to appear below the matched item row (like unmatched section) instead of inline to the right. This makes the layout consistent between auto-matched and unmatched sections.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Improve EPG modal UI:
1. Add tooltips (title attributes) to all truncated text so hovering shows full name
2. Change truncation priority in auto-matched items - EPG name shows in full, TVG-ID truncates
3. Replace AutoMatchEditor with EPGSearchCard component for consistent UI between matched and unmatched channel editing
4. Change EPG threshold setting from slider to number input

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed EPG matching to always perform prefix matching, not just when there are no exact matches. Previously, if there was an exact match (like 'Discovery.be'), prefix matches (like 'DiscoveryChannel.us') were never added to the candidate list. Now all prefix matches are found, and country sorting ensures the correct one is selected.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed EPG matching to prioritize country matching above all other criteria. Previously, exact name matches would beat country matching, causing 'Discovery' to match 'DiscoveryHD.be' over 'DiscoveryChannel.us'. Now country matching is the first sort criterion, ensuring US channels prefer US EPG entries. Also added default to US when no country is detected.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Improved EPG search in BulkEPGAssignModal with fuzzy multi-word matching. Search terms are split into words, and each word is matched against the EPG name, tvg_id, and normalized versions (alphanumeric only). This allows searching 'BBC News US' to match 'BBCNews(BBCNEEU).us'. Updated both EPGSearchCard and ConflictCard components.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Improved EPG matching for US/Canada broadcast TV stations with call signs (KATU, KOIN, WHA-DT, etc.). Added extractBroadcastCallSign() function to detect K/W call sign patterns in channel names like '21.1 | PBS: WHA-DT Madison'. The EPG lookup now indexes broadcast call signs from both channel names and EPG data, allowing channels with call signs to match EPG entries more accurately.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added epgChanges counter to EditModeSummary type and getSummary() function. When EPG is assigned to channels in edit mode, the summary now shows 'X EPG assignments' in the change list alongside other change types like channel number/name changes.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added margin-right to radio input and label, and margin-left to description to create proper spacing between radio button, label text, and description text in settings radio options.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added flex-direction: row and flex-wrap: nowrap to .radio-option CSS to prevent radio button and text from displaying on separate lines.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Changed the missing streams alert badge to a clickable button. When clicked, it expands all channel groups that contain channels without streams, making it easy to find and fix channels that need streams assigned.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added a warning alert badge in the Channels pane header that displays the count of channels without any streams. The badge shows an orange warning icon and the count, with a tooltip showing the full message. Only appears when there are channels missing streams.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: 1. Change country prefix options to a 3-way toggle (Remove/Keep as-is/Include normalized). 2. Change number separator from dropdown to symbol buttons like bulk add modal.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: 1. Investigate why channel 10.1 PBS shows 1 stream when it has none. 2. Add visual highlighting for channels that have no streams assigned.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Add a setting to hide Ungrouped streams by default in the streams pane, with toggle to show them

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Add expand all/collapse all buttons to the streams pane on the same line as the search field

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fix 5 UI quirks: (1) Stream grab handle position should be left of checkbox like groups, (2) Stream cursor shouldn't show grab outside edit mode, (3) Clicking stream shouldn't deselect other selected streams, (4) Checkbox area shouldn't trigger drag, (5) Channel insert indicator shouldn't show on hover without dragging

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed Apply Changes failing when channel groups or logos already exist in Dispatcharr. Updated dispatcharr_client.py to include response body in exceptions for better error messages. Updated main.py endpoints to handle 'already exists' errors by looking up and returning the existing resource instead of failing.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added a third option 'Insert at end' to the channel number conflict dialog that appears when creating channels that would overlap with existing channel numbers. This option allows users to insert new channels at the end of the existing sequence instead of pushing channels down or creating with duplicate numbers.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Replaced the plain select dropdown with a searchable dropdown for the 'Select existing group' option in the bulk create modal. Users can now type to filter groups instead of scrolling through a potentially long list.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: When selecting streams from a single group and clicking Create, now shows the same modal as drag-and-drop (with 'Use same name' option for channel group). Previously, clicking Create always showed a generic modal that treated streams as individual selections. Now the logic detects: 1) Multiple groups selected -> multi-group modal, 2) Single group selected -> same modal as drag-drop, 3) Individual streams (no group context) -> generic selection modal.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed stale closure bug in bulk channel creation modal. The handleBulkCreate callback was capturing a stale reference to doBulkCreate because: 1) doBulkCreate was defined AFTER handleBulkCreate in the code, and 2) doBulkCreate was missing from handleBulkCreate's dependency array. When user changed naming options (strip country, add channel number, etc.), the doBulkCreate function would be recreated with new values, but handleBulkCreate still held the old reference with default values. Fix: Moved doBulkCreate definition before handleBulkCreate, and added doBulkCreate to handleBulkCreate's dependency array.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Fixed blank logo image appearing when clicking 'Use EPG Logo' button. The issue was that when an existing logo was found, the image would display blank for 15-30 seconds while waiting for the cache_url to load. 

Solution: Added immediateLogoUrl state that stores the EPG icon_url for instant display while the logo data resolves. This ensures the user sees the logo immediately since they just saw it in the EPG picker.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Fix 'Use EPG Logo' button in Edit Channel Modal. When a logo with the same URL already exists in Dispatcharr, the backend was returning a 500 error instead of finding and returning the existing logo.

Changes made:
- Added find_logo_by_url method to DispatcharrClient (optimized to use search parameter instead of paginating through all logos)
- Modified create_logo endpoint in main.py to catch 'logo already exists' errors and return the existing logo
- Removed verbose debug logging from backend
- Frontend pendingLogo state pattern added in previous session (ChannelsPane.tsx)

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added pendingLogo state to track newly created logos for immediate display before the logos array prop updates.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: The onLogoCreate callback was not awaiting onLogosChange(), causing the logo to be created on the server but the local logos array not yet updated when setSelectedLogoId was called. Fixed by awaiting onLogosChange() to ensure logos are refreshed before returning.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Three fixes for the edit channel modal:
1. EPG dropdown now closes when clicking outside
2. Use EPG Logo button moved to logo section header line
3. Use EPG Logo button functionality fixed

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Fixed edit channel modal logo behavior:
1. Logo uploads no longer auto-select - user must manually click on the uploaded logo to select it, then Save Changes applies the change
2. Added 'Use EPG Logo' button that appears when EPG data with an icon is assigned to the channel - creates a logo from the EPG icon URL and selects it

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Fixed two issues with bulk channel creation modal:

1. Sort order - Preview now matches creation order by applying the same natural sort algorithm. Channels are sorted alphabetically with proper handling of trailing numbers (e.g., 'C-SPAN', 'C-SPAN 2', 'C-SPAN 3').

2. Decimal channel numbers - Starting number field now accepts decimals (e.g., 38.1). When a decimal is detected:
   - Increment by 0.1 instead of 1 (38.1 -> 38.2 -> 38.3)
   - Preview shows correct decimal numbers
   - Channel numbers are rounded to 1 decimal place to avoid floating point issues

Files changed:
- StreamsPane.tsx: Added sort to bulkCreateStats, updated number input to step='any', updated preview and validation to use parseFloat
- App.tsx: Detect decimal starting numbers and use 0.1 increment

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Fixed three channel profile issues:

1. ECM UI showing channels enabled for all profiles - Changed ChannelProfilesListModal.tsx to treat empty channels array as 'none enabled' instead of 'all enabled'

2. Channels not being added to selected profiles - Root cause was edit mode using temp IDs (-1, -2, etc). Fixed by passing profileIds to onCreateChannel, which stores them in pendingProfileAssignmentsRef for edit mode (applied after commit) or calls API immediately for normal mode.

3. Toggle click not working in Channel Profiles modal - Fixed by adding stopPropagation on the label and proper onChange handler on the checkbox.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Bug: Channels are being added to all channel profiles by default, even when user hasn't selected those profiles. Need to investigate the channel creation/addition logic.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Added EPG search functionality for unmatched channels and conflicts in Bulk EPG Assignment modal.

Features:
- Unmatched channels now show a search icon - click to search all EPG data
- When an EPG is assigned to an unmatched channel, it shows with a green checkmark
- Header shows count of manually assigned unmatched channels
- ConflictCard now has mode toggle: 'Suggestions' (default) vs 'Search All EPG'
- 'Search All EPG' mode searches across all filtered EPG data (limited to 50 results)
- Search is pre-populated with the normalized channel name
- All manual assignments from unmatched channels are included in final assignment

Files modified:
- BulkEPGAssignModal.tsx: Added state, handlers, and EPGSearchCard component
- BulkEPGAssignModal.css: Added styles for clickable items, search card, mode toggle

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Added EPG source selection to the Bulk EPG Assignment modal. Features:
- Dropdown in modal header to select which EPG sources to include in matching
- Excludes dummy EPG sources, only shows active xmltv/schedules_direct sources
- Shows source name and channel count for each source
- Select All / Clear buttons for quick selection
- Re-analyze button to re-run matching with new source selection
- State resets when modal closes

This is a simpler implementation without drag-and-drop priority ordering (the original DnD implementation caused React crashes). The matching uses all selected sources equally.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added EPG source selection with drag-and-drop priority ordering to the Bulk EPG Assignment modal. Users can now select which EPG sources to match against and reorder them to set matching priority. Higher priority sources (at top of list) are checked first. Dummy EPG sources are excluded. Includes Re-analyze button to re-run matching after changing selection.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed CSS class collision between StreamsPane and ChannelsPane. Both used .pane-filters with different styles (ChannelsPane had height: 96px). Renamed StreamsPane classes to .streams-pane-filters and .streams-filter-row to avoid conflicts when switching tabs.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fixed StreamsPane filter dropdowns layout issue. Removed fixed height from pane-filters container, added flex-shrink: 0 to prevent collapsing, and added min-width: 0 to filter-row and filter-dropdown for proper flex behavior.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Removed pagination from Logo Manager tab. All logos now load at once (up to 10000) in both list and grid views. Removed pagination state, handlers, UI, and CSS. Header now shows total count.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Improved grid view card text styling:
- Smaller font size (0.8rem) for logo names
- Centered text alignment below the logo
- Smaller channel count badge (16px height, 0.65rem font)
- Reduced padding for more compact cards
- Smaller action buttons (24px) with 14px icons

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Added width: 100% and box-sizing: border-box to .logo-manager-tab class to ensure the tab content fills the full width of the main container.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Fixed Logo Manager grid view to use full page width instead of only showing 3 columns.

Changes:
- Added width: 100% to .logos-container to ensure it spans full width
- Added width: 100% to .logos-grid to fill its container
- Increased minimum card size from 160px to 180px for better proportions

The grid now properly uses auto-fill to create as many columns as will fit based on available width.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Implemented full Logo Manager tab replacing the placeholder. Features include:

- **Dual View Modes**: List view (table format) and Grid view (card format) with toggle button
- **Drag & Drop Upload**: Primary method for adding logos - drag image files onto the drop zone
- **URL Input**: Fallback method to add logos via URL
- **Search**: Debounced search filtering by logo name
- **Pagination**: Page navigation with configurable page size (25, 50, 100)
- **Edit Logo**: Update logo name and URL
- **Delete Logo**: With confirmation dialog and warning if logo is in use by channels
- **Copy URL**: Click button to copy logo URL to clipboard
- **Channel Usage**: Shows how many channels use each logo
- **Broken Image Handling**: Shows placeholder icon for broken logo URLs
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-friendly layout adjustments

Files created:
- frontend/src/components/tabs/LogoManagerTab.css (full styling)
- frontend/src/components/LogoModal.tsx (add/edit modal with drag & drop)
- frontend/src/components/LogoModal.css (modal styling)

Files modified:
- frontend/src/components/tabs/LogoManagerTab.tsx (replaced placeholder)

title: Add Sync Groups button for linked M3U accounts

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Fixed EPG matching to properly balance HD preference with call sign quality.

Issues fixed:
- US | 5050 - FYI: now prefers FYIChannelHD(FYIHD).us over FYI(FYISD).us
- US | 5051 - GET TV: now prefers getHD(GETHD).us over get(GETTVS).us
- US | 5079 - Lifetime Movie: now prefers LMNHD(LMNHD).us
- US | 5086 - MGM+: now prefers MGM+HD(MGMHD).us over MGM+West(MGMW).us
- US | 5092 - Ovation: now prefers OvationHD(OVATNHD).us over Ovation(OVATION).us
- US | 5097 - Pursuit: now prefers PursuitChannelHD(PURSTHD).us over PursuitUP(PRSTUP).us
- US | 5102 - Reelz: now prefers ReelzChannelHD(REELZHD).us over REELZ(VIZREEL).us
- US | 5113 - Tastemade Travel: now prefers TastemadeTravel(TMTRAVEL).us (actually this one should still work from v65)
- US | 5116 - TCM: now prefers TurnerClassicMoviesHD(TCMHD).us over TCM.us
- US | 5125 - TV Land: now prefers TVLandHD(TVLNDHD).us over TVLand(TVLAND).us

Root cause:
Previous logic (v65) prioritized call sign match quality over HD preference. This caused issues where non-HD variants with slightly better call sign matches (e.g., TVLAND exact match) were preferred over HD variants with good-but-not-exact call signs (e.g., TVLNDHD).

Solution:
Combined HD preference with call sign scoring. Now:
- When comparing HD vs non-HD, prefer HD UNLESS:
  - The non-HD has a MUCH better call sign (score difference >= 2)
  - AND the HD variant has a poor call sign (score <= 1)
- This means NOSEY (score 3) still beats VIZNOSE-HD (score 0)
- But TVLNDHD (score 2) now beats TVLAND (score 3) because diff is only 1

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description:
Fixed EPG matching to prefer call signs that better match the channel name.

Issues fixed:
- US | 5089 - Nosey: now prefers Nosey(NOSEY).us over Nosey(VIZNOSE).us
- US | 5097 - Pursuit: now prefers PursuitChannelHD(PURSTHD).us over PursuitUP(PRSTUP).us
- US | 5102 - Reelz: now prefers ReelzChannelHD(REELZHD).us over REELZ(VIZREEL).us
- US | 5113 - Tastemade Travel: now prefers TastemadeTravel(TMTRAVEL).us over TastemadeTravel(VIZTASTR).us
- US | 5116 - TCM: now prefers TurnerClassicMoviesHD(TCMHD).us over TCM.us
- US | 5117 - The Cowboy Channel: now prefers HD variant
- US | 5120 - The Pet Collective: now prefers ThePetCollective(PETCOLL).us over ThePetCollective(XALPTCL).us

Root cause:
The call sign matching logic only compared call signs when both EPG entries had them, and was positioned after HD preference in sort priority. Call signs like VIZNOSE, VIZREEL, XALPTCL don't contain the channel name, while NOSEY, REELZHD, PETCOLL do.

Solution:
- Added a call sign scoring function that rates how well the call sign matches the channel name:
  - Score 3: exact match (call sign equals normalized name)
  - Score 2: call sign starts with normalized name (e.g., REELZHD starts with REELZ)
  - Score 1: significant common prefix (60%+ overlap)
  - Score 0: no meaningful match
- Moved call sign matching BEFORE HD preference in sort priority
- Now handles entries without call signs gracefully (score 0)

title: Improve regional variant detection for WestCoastFeed etc

comments.author: user
comments.text:
Fixed regional variant detection to catch more patterns like WestCoastFeed.

Issue: 'MotorTrend' was matching 'MotorTrend(WestCoastFeed)(MTPHD).us' over 'MOTORTRENDHD(MTHD).us' because 'WestCoastFeed' wasn't being detected as a regional variant.

Fix: Expanded the regional pattern to match more variants:
- Old: /\((Pacific|East|West|Central|Mountain)\)/i
- New: /\((Pacific|East(?:ern)?(?:Feed)?|West(?:ern)?(?:Coast)?(?:Feed)?|Central|Mountain)\)/i

Now matches:
- Pacific
- East, Eastern, EastFeed, EasternFeed
- West, Western, WestCoast, WestCoastFeed, WesternFeed
- Central
- Mountain

Since 'MotorTrend' has no region hint, it defaults to preferring East, and the WestCoastFeed variant is now correctly deprioritized.

title: Deprioritize regional EPG variants like Pacific/East/West

comments.author: lecaptainc
comments.text:
Fixed regional EPG variant matching with smart defaults.

Issue: 'FYI' was matching 'FYIHD(Pacific)(FYIPHD).us' when 'FYI(FYI).us' or 'FYIChannelHD(FYIHD).us' were available.

Fix: Added intelligent regional variant handling:
1. If channel name contains 'West' or 'Pacific' → prefer Pacific/West variants
2. If channel name contains 'East' → prefer East variants
3. If channel name contains 'Central' → prefer Central variants
4. If channel name contains 'Mountain' → prefer Mountain variants
5. If no region hint in channel name → default to East variants
6. Non-matching regional variants are deprioritized after non-regional

Sort priority:
1. Matching regional variant (if requested)
2. Non-regional variants (if no matching regional)
3. Wrong regional variants (last resort)

Example behavior:
- 'FYI' → prefers East variant or non-regional
- 'FYI West' → prefers Pacific variant
- 'FYI East' → prefers East variant

5. If no region hint in channel name → default to East variants
6. Non-matching regional variants are deprioritized after non-regional

Sort priority:
1. Matching regional variant (if requested)
2. Non-regional variants (if no matching regional)
3. Wrong regional variants (last resort)

Example behavior:
- 'FYI' → prefers East variant or non-regional
- 'FYI West' → prefers Pacific variant
- 'FYI East' → prefers East variant

title: Fix E! channel matching to E!Entertainment

comments.author: lecaptainc
comments.text:
Fixed E! channel matching to prefer E!EntertainmentTelevisionHD(EHD).us over E.us.

Root cause: 'E!' normalizes to just 'e', and 'E.us' was an exact match for 'e'. The EPG entry 'E!EntertainmentTelevisionHD(EHD).us' normalizes to 'eentertainmenttelevisionhd' which would only match via prefix matching, but prefix matching was skipped when exact matches existed.

Two-part fix:
1. For very short normalized names (1-2 chars), also try prefix matching even when exact matches exist - single letters are too generic to rely on exact matching alone
2. For short names, don't prioritize exact matches over prefix matches in sorting
3. Added special punctuation matching - prefer EPG entries that share special chars like '!' with the original channel name

Now 'E!' will match 'E!Entertainment' because:
- Both 'E.us' (exact) and 'E!EntertainmentTelevisionHD' (prefix) are found
- The '!' in the channel name prefers the EPG entry with '!' in its TVG-ID

title: Fix article stripping breaking AWE channel matching

comments.author: lecaptainc
comments.text:
Fixed article stripping breaking AWE channel matching.

Root cause: The regex `/^(the|a|an)(?=[a-z])/` was stripping the 'a' from 'awe' because:
- 'a' matches the article pattern
- 'we' follows (a letter follows after 'a')

This turned 'awe' into 'we', which couldn't match the call sign 'awe' (from AWEHD).

Fix: Added minimum length requirement (4+ chars) for the remaining text after stripping an article.
- 'awe' → 'we' (2 chars) - too short, no stripping → remains 'awe' ✓
- 'thebobrosschannel' → 'bobrosschannel' (14 chars) - long enough, strips → 'bobrosschannel' ✓

description:

Algorithm:

- Provider 1 ESPN HD
- Provider 2 ESPN HD

This ensures that if a provider fails, the next stream in the failover chain is from a different provider at the same quality level.

description: When bulk creating channels from streams with country prefixes (e.g., 'US: ESPN'), give users the option to keep the country prefix in the channel name with a customizable separator (|, -, or :). Normalize the format to consistent spacing.
notes:
Implemented country prefix retention feature for bulk channel creation:
- Added keepCountryPrefix and countrySeparator options to BulkCreateOptions interface
- Updated NormalizeOptions to support keeping country prefix with custom separator
- Modified normalizeStreamName() to handle keepCountryPrefix option
- Added radio button UI in bulk create modal: Remove prefix vs Keep prefix (normalized)
- Keep prefix option shows separator selector (-, :, |) like channel numbers
- Updated StreamsPane.tsx with new state and UI components
- Updated ChannelManagerTab.tsx and App.tsx to pass new parameters
- Added CSS for radio hints and country separator styling

title: Bulk reorder streams by quality for existing channels
description: Added bulk reorder streams by quality feature. When channels are selected in edit mode, a new 'Sort' button appears that reorders all streams within each selected channel by quality (UHD/4K first, then FHD/1080p, then HD/720p, then SD). Uses the same quality priority system as bulk channel creation. Changes are staged and can be undone. Version 0.2.30003.

title: Default stream ordering by quality when creating channels
description: Implemented stream quality ordering for bulk channel creation. Added getStreamQualityPriority() and sortStreamsByQuality() functions. Streams are now sorted by quality (UHD/4K first, then FHD/1080p, then HD/720p, then SD) before being added to channels. Streams without quality indicators default to HD/720p position. Logo selection also prefers highest quality stream. Version 0.2.30002.

title: Improve bulk EPG conflict resolution UX - collapsible items with next/back navigation
description: Make conflict items collapsible (default collapsed), add next/back navigation to go through one-by-one, highlight the recommended best match based on country detection.
notes: Improved bulk EPG conflict resolution UX: made conflict items collapsible with one expanded at a time, added next/back navigation buttons to step through conflicts, highlighted recommended best match with country-aware sorting and visual styling

title: Fix bulk EPG matching - exact matching too strict, no matches found
description: Fixed bulk EPG matching - now matches against: 1) normalized TVG-ID name part, 2) call sign extracted from TVG-ID parentheses (e.g., 'CNN' from 'CableNewsNetwork(CNN).us'), 3) normalized EPG name field. This resolves the issue where exact matching was too strict because TVG-IDs use format 'ChannelName(CallSign).country' but channel names are typically just the call sign.

title: enhancedchannelmanager
description: Fix shift-click stream selection using wrong array order - streams are displayed grouped and sorted but useSelection received original unsorted array

title: Improve bulk EPG matching to show country variants as conflicts
description: Fixed bulk EPG matching: removed loose partial name matching that was causing false positives (e.g., 'E.us' matching everything). Now only exact normalized name matches are used. Also fixed channel number prefix stripping in normalization (e.g., '107 | CNN' now normalizes to 'cnn' not '107cnn').
notes:
Fixed infinite loop in BulkEPGAssignModal - added useRef to track if analysis has run for current modal session. Also:
- Changed matching to show ALL exact name matches regardless of country (for review)
- Sections expanded by default
- Added console logging for debugging

title: Fix BulkEPGAssignModal CSS using undefined variables
notes: Fixed BulkEPGAssignModal.css - replaced undefined CSS variables (--bg-secondary, --bg-tertiary, --text-primary, etc.) with actual hardcoded color values (#2d2d2d, #1e1e1e, #fff, #888, etc.) matching the app's existing color scheme

title: Bulk EPG Assignment feature with country-aware matching
description: Add intelligent bulk EPG assignment to channels. Detects country from stream names/groups, matches to EPG entries with country suffix filtering, queues conflicts for user review.
notes:
Implemented bulk EPG assignment feature:
- Created epgMatching.ts utility with country-aware matching algorithm
- Created BulkEPGAssignModal.tsx component with conflict resolution UI
- Created BulkEPGAssignModal.css styles
- Integrated modal into ChannelsPane.tsx with EPG button in selection header
- Added button styles to ChannelsPane.css
- Build successful and container deployed v0.2.20015

title: Fix Refresh All EPG - endpoint not triggering import in Dispatcharr
description: Dispatcharr's /api/epg/import/ endpoint requires an ID in the body - it doesn't support 'refresh all' mode. Fixed by iterating over all active non-dummy sources and triggering each one individually.

title: Add parsed programs count to EPG stats display
description: Show the number of programs parsed for each EPG source in the stats column, extracted from the last_message field (e.g., '96,514 programs'). The program count is displayed in green when available, otherwise falls back to showing refresh interval.
notes:
Implemented:
1. Added getProgramCount() helper to parse 'Parsed X programs' from last_message
2. Display program count in green in stats column when available
3. Falls back to refresh interval when no program count available
4. Added .program-count CSS class with green color (#22c55e)

title: Add detailed EPG refresh status with progress information
description:
Added detailed EPG refresh status with progress information:
- Status column now shows status label (Ready, Downloading..., Parsing..., Error, Idle, Disabled)
- Spinning icon during fetching/parsing states
- Shows last_message from Dispatcharr during active refresh or on error
- Polling now checks every 2 seconds instead of 3
- Polling automatically stops when refresh completes
- Widened status column from 50px to 80px for status labels

title: Fix individual EPG source refresh endpoint
description: Added individual EPG source refresh endpoint. Backend: added refresh_epg_source method to dispatcharr_client.py and /api/epg/sources/{id}/refresh route to main.py. Frontend: restored refreshEPGSource function in api.ts and updated EPGManagerTab to use it. Endpoint pattern follows /api/epg/sources/{id}/refresh/ similar to M3U refresh pattern.

title: Implement EPG Manager tab with drag-and-drop priority ordering
description:
Implemented EPG Manager tab with full functionality:
- Updated EPGSource type with all fields from Dispatcharr API (source_type, priority, status, refresh_interval, etc.)
- Added API functions: createEPGSource, updateEPGSource, deleteEPGSource, refreshEPGSource, triggerEPGImport
- Created EPGManagerTab component with drag-and-drop priority reordering using @dnd-kit
- Added EPGSourceModal for creating/editing EPG sources (XMLTV and Schedules Direct types)
- Shows source status (success/error/fetching/parsing), channel count, last update time
- Actions: toggle active, refresh, edit, delete
- Filters out dummy EPG sources (standard EPGs only)
- Created EPGManagerTab.css with full styling for list, modal, and responsive layout

title: Add M3U Manager tab and reorder tabs
description: Added M3U Manager tab as placeholder. Reordered tabs to: M3U Manager, EPG Manager, Channel Manager, Logo Manager, Settings. Updated TabNavigation.tsx with new tab type and order. Created M3UManagerTab.tsx placeholder component. Updated App.tsx with lazy loading for M3UManagerTab. Updated README.md with new tab order. Fixed Settings label text for timezone.

title: Add Channel Defaults settings section with sidebar navigation and bulk create integration
description: Added Channel Defaults as a new sidebar section in Settings tab. New settings include: include channel number in name, number separator choice, remove country prefix, and timezone preference (East/West/Both). These defaults are loaded in the bulk create modal and show '(from settings)' indicator when active. Backend config.py and main.py updated with new fields. Frontend StreamsPane, ChannelManagerTab, App.tsx, and SettingsModal updated to handle the new settings.

title: Add channel number prefix feature with separator choice
description: Implemented channel number prefix feature with separator choice (-, :, |) in bulk channel creation modal. Reorganized modal UI with collapsible 'Naming Options' section that groups country prefix and channel number options together. Updated api.ts, StreamsPane.tsx, StreamsPane.css, App.tsx, and README.md. Version 0.1.17.

title: Add country prefix removal option for bulk channel creation
description: When bulk creating channels, detect country prefixes (US, UK, CA, etc.) and offer option to remove them from channel names.
notes: Completed: Added country prefix removal option for bulk channel creation. When streams have country prefixes (US, UK, CA, etc.), users can choose to remove them from channel names. Detection is automatic - the option only appears when country prefixes are detected in the stream group. The prefix and any trailing punctuation (colon, hyphen, slash) are removed.

title: Add East/West timezone preference for bulk channel creation
notes: Completed: Added East/West timezone preference for bulk channel creation. When streams have regional variants (e.g., HBO and HBO West), users can choose: East Coast (use East feeds, skip West), West Coast (use West feeds only), or Keep Both (create separate channels). Detection is automatic - the option only appears when regional variants are detected in the stream group.

title: Normalize stream names to merge quality variants (FHD, UHD, HD, SD)
notes: Completed: normalizeStreamName function strips quality suffixes (FHD, UHD, HD, SD, 4K, 1080P, etc.) from stream names for matching. Updated bulkCreateChannelsFromStreams to use normalized names. Updated StreamsPane modal preview to show normalized channel names with stream counts for merged channels.

title: Make stream checkboxes match channel checkboxes using Material Icons
description: Changed stream checkboxes from Unicode characters to Material Icons to match channel checkboxes. Both now use check_box/check_box_outline_blank icons at 1.1rem.

title: Fix checkbox click in streams pane to toggle selection
description: Clicking the checkbox on a stream now toggles selection without requiring Ctrl/Cmd key. Added toggleSelect function to useSelection hook and wired it to the checkbox click handler with stopPropagation. Added hover styling to make checkbox look interactive.

title: Show duplicate stream count in bulk create modal before creation
description: Bulk create modal now detects duplicate stream names before creation and shows accurate channel count. When duplicates exist, displays: 'X channels will be created from Y streams (Z duplicate names will be merged)'. Channel number range and Create button reflect the actual unique count.

title: Merge streams with identical names during bulk channel creation
description: When bulk creating channels from a stream group, streams with identical names from different M3U providers are now merged into a single channel with all matching streams assigned. This provides multi-provider redundancy. The success message now shows how many streams were merged.

title: Add bulk channel creation from stream groups
description: Add ability to bulk create channels from M3U stream groups. Features: button on stream group headers in Streams pane (visible in edit mode), modal to configure starting channel number and target channel group, auto-assign each stream to its created channel, option to use same group name or select/create different group.
close_reason: Feature fully implemented - bulk create button on stream group headers, modal with channel number, group selection, timezone preference, country prefix removal, and preview

title: Update CodeQL from v3 to v4
Fix DAST scan still failing on warnings
Fix IaC and DAST security scan failures in CI/CD
Fix Trivy scan failing due to uppercase in image name
Add IaC scanning and DAST testing to CI/CD pipeline
Fix Python dependency security vulnerabilities
description: Updated Python dependencies to fix security vulnerabilities: fastapi 0.109.0->0.115.0+ (PYSEC-2024-38), python-multipart 0.0.6->0.0.18+ (CVE-2024-24762, CVE-2024-53981), starlette via fastapi update (CVE-2024-47874, CVE-2025-54121). Also updated uvicorn, httpx, pydantic, and pydantic-settings to latest stable versions.

title: Add security scanning to CI/CD pipeline
description: Added comprehensive security scanning to CI/CD pipeline: npm audit for frontend dependencies (fails on high/critical), pip-audit for backend Python dependencies, CodeQL analysis for JavaScript/TypeScript and Python code scanning, Trivy container vulnerability scanner for the built Docker image (fails on high/critical). All security scans must pass before the build job can run.

title: Setup GitHub Actions CI/CD for dev and main branches
description: Created GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow that: builds Docker images on push to dev and main branches, pushes to GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io), uses Docker Buildx for multi-platform builds (amd64, arm64), includes caching for faster builds, creates appropriate tags (branch name, SHA, latest for main, dev for dev branch), also builds on PRs to main (but doesn't push).

title: Create README.md documentation
description: Created comprehensive README.md documenting all features including: channel management, stream management, edit mode with staged editing, drag-and-drop, multi-select, sort and renumber, logo management, EPG integration, stream profiles, global history, channel list filters, provider management, API endpoints, keyboard shortcuts, and deployment instructions.

title: Add option to strip channel numbers from names when sorting
description: Added option to Sort & Renumber modal to strip channel numbers from names when sorting. This allows channels like '101 | ESPN' to sort as 'ESPN' instead of starting with '1'. The option is enabled by default and includes: new state (sortStripNumbers), helper function (getNameForSorting), updated sorting logic in both confirm handler and preview, checkbox UI in modal, and CSS styling.

title: Sort and renumber channels in a group - sort alphabetically by name and renumber starting at user-chosen number
description: Added Sort & Renumber feature for channel groups. In edit mode, a sort button appears on group headers when hovering. Clicking it opens a modal that shows a preview of channels sorted alphabetically with sequential numbers starting from a user-chosen number. The operation is batched as a single undo step.

title: Fix modifiedChannelIds not updating correctly on undo/redo operations
description: Added computeModifiedChannelIds helper function that compares working copy against baseline snapshot. Updated localUndo and localRedo to recalculate modifiedChannelIds after each operation, so the 'modified' highlighting accurately reflects only channels that differ from baseline at each step.

title: Show undo entry count instead of individual operation count
description: Changed stagedOperationCount to show the number of undo entries (batches) instead of individual operations. This means if a cross-group move creates 3 batches (move, shift, renumber) containing 14 total operations, the UI will show '3 changes' instead of '14 changes'.

title: Smarter undo batching for cross-group channel moves
description: Implemented smarter undo batching for cross-group channel moves. Now creates separate undo entries for each logical phase: (1) Move channels to target group, (2) Shift existing channels in target group if inserting at a position, (3) Renumber remaining channels in source group if closing gaps. This gives users 1-3 undo steps instead of one giant batch, allowing them to step through the operation logically.

title: Batch related operations into single undo/redo point
description: Implemented batch undo/redo to group multiple related operations into a single undo point. Added UndoEntry type that contains an array of StagedOperations. Added startBatch/endBatch functions to useEditMode hook. Updated handleCrossGroupMoveConfirm and handleDragEnd to wrap multiple operations in a batch. Now moving channels between groups or reordering within a group creates a single undo point regardless of how many individual channel updates occur.

title: Fix undo/redo not updating UI in ChannelsPane
description: Fixed undo/redo not visually reverting changes in the UI. The issue was that ChannelsPane has its own localChannels state for drag operations, which was only syncing with the channels prop when entering/exiting edit mode. Now it also syncs when channels changes during edit mode (which happens when undo/redo updates the workingCopy), but only when not actively dragging to preserve drag state.

title: Fix group-end drop zone detection for cross-group moves
description: Fixed group-end drop zone detection by moving DroppableGroupEnd outside SortableContext. Also moved custom number input inline within the radio option selection.

title: Fix dropping channels at end of group
description: Added DroppableGroupEnd component using @dnd-kit's useDroppable hook to allow dropping channels at the end of a group. Updated handleDragOver and handleDragEnd to handle group-end-{groupId} drop targets. The drop zone appears after the last channel in each group and shows a drop indicator line when hovering.

title: Redesign cross-group move modal with radio selections and single action button
description: Redesigned the cross-group move modal to use radio button selections instead of action buttons. Options (Keep current numbers, Assign sequential numbers, Custom number) are now selectable with a single 'Move Channel(s)' button at the bottom. The custom number input only appears when that option is selected. This makes the modal flow clearer and more intuitive.

title: Add option to renumber source group after cross-group move
description: Added option to renumber source group after moving channels to a different group. When channels are moved out of a group and create gaps in the channel numbering, a checkbox appears in the cross-group move modal offering to 'Close gaps in source group'. When checked, the remaining channels in the source group are renumbered sequentially starting from the original minimum channel number, with auto-rename applied if enabled.

title: Fix header and filter height alignment between panes
description: Changed both header sections (.pane-header) and filter sections (.pane-filters) from min-height to fixed height in ChannelsPane.css and StreamsPane.css. This ensures both panes have exactly the same header height (56px) and filter height (96px) for a continuous visual appearance.

title: Fix mismatched filter section heights between Channels and Streams panes
description: The filter areas have different heights due to different filter row structures.

title: Fix mismatched header heights between Channels and Streams panes
description: The Channels pane header is taller than the Streams pane header due to additional edit mode elements. Add consistent min-height to both headers.

title: Fix cross-group insert to renumber existing channels
description:
Fixed cross-group insert to properly renumber existing channels at insertion point.

When inserting a channel between other channels in a different group using the 'Insert at position' option:
- Existing channels at and after the insertion point are now shifted up by the number of channels being inserted
- Auto-rename is applied to shifted channels if enabled (e.g., '100 ESPN' becomes '101 ESPN')
- Both moved and shifted channel updates are staged as separate operations for undo/redo support
- Prevents duplicate channel numbers that would have occurred before this fix

title: Add visual drop indicator between channels when dragging
description:
Added a visual drop indicator that shows between channels when dragging. When dragging a channel over other channels, a glowing purple/blue line appears to show exactly where the channel will be inserted. Features:

- Added dropIndicator state to track which channel is being hovered and whether to show indicator before or after
- Updated handleDragOver to calculate drop position based on drag direction and target channel
- Modified renderGroup to render visual drop indicator lines between channels
- Added CSS animations with pulsing glow effect for the drop indicator
- Shows indicator before target channel when moving up or across groups
- Shows indicator after target channel when moving down within same group
- Indicator clears when drag ends or moves to group header

title: Allow dropping channels between other channels within a group
description: Allow dropping channels onto other channels in a different group to trigger cross-group move. When dropping on a specific channel, the suggested channel number is the drop target's number. Modal shows 'Insert at position' with playlist_add icon when dropping on a channel vs 'Assign sequential numbers' when dropping on a group header.

title: Add drag overlay preview when moving channels
description: Added a drag overlay that shows a visual preview when dragging channels. The overlay displays the drag indicator icon, channel number, and channel name. When dragging multiple selected channels, it shows '+X more' badge to indicate the total count being moved.

title: Fix cross-group move modal width for custom starting number option
description: Increased cross-group move modal width from 480px to 500-560px to accommodate the custom starting number option. Also increased custom number input field width from 100-120px to 120-140px.

title: Add custom starting number option to cross-group move modal
description: Added a third option to the cross-group move modal that allows users to specify a custom starting channel number when moving channels between groups. Changes: 1) Added customStartingNumber state to ChannelsPane.tsx 2) Reset custom number when modal closes 3) Added new 'Custom starting number' section with input field, Apply button, and range preview for multi-channel moves 4) Added CSS styles for the new option (.move-option-custom, .custom-number-row, .custom-number-input, .custom-number-apply-btn, .custom-number-range)

title: Add multi-select channel functionality for bulk moves
notes:
Implemented multi-select functionality for channels:
- Added selectedChannelIds state and handlers in App.tsx
- Ctrl/Cmd+click to toggle individual channel selection
- Shift+click to select range of channels within a group
- Visual checkbox indicators in edit mode
- Multi-selected channels highlighted with blue styling
- Dragging a selected channel drags all selected channels
- Cross-group move modal updated to show multiple channels being moved
- Sequential channel number assignment option when moving multiple channels
- Auto-rename applied to each channel when numbers change

title: Fix text contrast in edit mode done count badge
notes: Changed .edit-mode-done-count badge from light green (#4ade80) with dark text to darker green (#16a34a) with white text (#ffffff) for better contrast and readability

title: Improve readability of edit mode info in channel edit modal
description: Improved readability of edit mode info text in the channel pane header. Changed edit-mode-count color from #c7d2fe to #e0e7ff (brighter) and edit-mode-duration color from #818cf8 to #a5b4fc (brighter) for better contrast against the dark background.

title: Add auto-rename when assigning new channel number in cross-group move
description: Added auto-rename functionality when assigning a new channel number during cross-group moves. Uses the existing computeAutoRename function to update the channel name if the channel number appears in the name (e.g., '123 | Channel Name' becomes '456 | Channel Name' when moved to channel 456). The name change is included in both the local state update and the staged operation.

title: Fix incorrect auto-sync indicator flagging
description: Investigated auto-sync indicator showing on SiriusXM: Sports Talk. Found that the frontend logic is working correctly - the group is marked as auto-sync because the Infinity M3U account has group 86 configured with auto_channel_sync: true and group_override: 371 (SiriusXM: Sports Talk). This is a backend data configuration issue, not a frontend bug. The indicator correctly shows that group 371 receives auto-created channels from group 86. Debug logging was added temporarily and then removed.

title: Add auto-sync indicator to channel group headers
notes: Added sync icon indicator to channel group headers for groups that are auto-populated by channel sync. The icon appears after the group name with a tooltip explaining what it means.

title: Add modal for cross-group channel drag with number options and auto-sync warning
notes:
Added cross-group move modal that appears when dragging a channel to a different group header. The modal:
1. Shows source and target group names
2. Displays warning if target group is auto-populated by channel sync
3. Shows the target group's channel number range
4. Offers two options: keep current channel number or assign next available number in the target group's range
5. Full CSS styling matching the app's design language

title: Sort selected groups to top of dropdown
notes: Sorted selected groups to top of dropdown by adding a sort function that prioritizes selected groups (checked items) before unselected ones, maintaining alphabetical order within each section

title: Rework group filter to auto-select groups with channels
description:
Reworked group filter to auto-select groups with channels:

1. Added useEffect in App.tsx that auto-selects all groups containing channels when data first loads
2. Added channelGroupFilterInitialized ref to prevent overriding user selections after initial load
3. Reverted renderGroup to filter based on selectedGroups (only show groups in the selection)
4. Updated dropdown to show all groups (not just empty ones)
5. Button shows 'N group(s) selected' or 'No groups selected'
6. Uncategorized group always shows if it has channels (it's not in channelGroups array)

Behavior:
- On load, groups with channels are automatically checked in the dropdown
- Users can uncheck groups to hide them
- Users can check empty groups to show them
- The selection persists until page refresh

title: Change group filter to show used groups by default
description:
Changed group filter behavior so groups with channels are always shown by default:

1. Removed the filter logic that hid groups when selectedGroups was populated
2. Changed dropdown to only show empty groups (groups with channels are always visible)
3. Updated button text: 'Show Empty Groups' when none selected, '+N empty group(s)' when some selected
4. Updated dropdown placeholder and empty state messages
5. Uncategorized group now always shows if it has channels (not dependent on selectedGroups)

The selectedGroups array now controls which additional empty groups to show, rather than filtering which groups are visible.

title: Fix channel drag between groups in edit mode
description:
Implemented cross-group channel dragging in edit mode:

1. Added useDroppable import from @dnd-kit/core
2. Created DroppableGroupHeader component that makes group headers droppable targets
3. Moved DndContext from per-group to wrap all groups in pane-content
4. Updated handleDragEnd to detect drops on group headers (group-{id}) and move channels between groups
5. Added CSS styling for drop-target state on group headers (dashed purple border)

When dragging a channel onto a different group's header:
- The channel's group_id is updated
- A staged operation is created with description like 'Moved X from Y to Z'
- Local state updates immediately for smooth UX

title: Add channel list filtering toggles to settings
Show auto channel groups but hide empty groups unless selected or newly created
Show all channel groups including empty ones in channel list
description: Remove filter that hides empty channel groups from channel list

title: Add channel groups to visible list on-demand
description: Allow users to selectively add channel groups to the channel list view, either by selecting them in the filter or when creating a new group

title: Show empty channel groups in channel list for drag-drop assignment
description: Empty channel groups should appear in the channel list so users can drag channels into them

title: Searchable group filter dropdown in Channels pane
Add channel group creation in edit mode
Swap Cancel and Done button positions
Fix edit mode button sizes and add X icon to Cancel
Move edit mode UI from banner to Channels pane header
Add Cancel Edit Mode button with confirmation
description: Add a Cancel button to exit edit mode. If there are staged changes, show a confirmation dialog before discarding them.

title: Fix Edit Mode timer not updating
description: The Edit Mode Active timer shows (0s) and never updates. Fix the timer to properly count up while in edit mode.

title: Replace Cancel button with unsaved changes confirmation
description: Remove redundant Cancel button from Edit Channel modal. Add confirmation dialog when closing with unsaved changes asking user to confirm discarding changes.

title: Fix Add and Upload button size mismatch
description: Make the Add and Upload buttons the same height in the logo add row

title: Move Upload Image button inline with URL input
description: Move the Upload Image button to be on the same line as the Add logo from URL input, removing the 'or' divider for a more consistent layout

title: Add file upload functionality for logos in Edit Channel modal
description: Added ability to upload logo images from local files in the Edit Channel modal. Added file input with hidden input, 'Upload Image' button, CSS styling for the upload section with 'or' divider between URL and file options.

title: Add channel number and name editing to Edit Channel modal
description: Extended Edit Channel modal to allow editing channel number and name fields. Added ChannelMetadataChanges interface fields, state management, editable header fields UI, and corresponding CSS styles.

title: Fix EPG dropdown color contrast for better readability
description: Changed EPG dropdown colors to improve readability on dark background: name from #ccc to #fff, tvgid from #666 to #aaa, source from #646cff to #a8b4ff with lighter background

title: Add OS-style window titlebar to Edit Channel modal
Update Get from EPG button to copy TVG-ID when EPG data is selected
Add EPG source name display in EPG data dropdowns
Fix EPG Data search with client-side filtering
description: Dispatcharr's EPG data API doesn't support server-side search. Implemented client-side filtering: EPG data is loaded once on mount, and search terms filter the local data by name or tvg_id. Also increased dropdown height from 200px to 300px and display limit from 50 to 100 items.

title: Fix EPG Data API response handling
description: The frontend expected a paginated response with .results property, but Dispatcharr's EPG data endpoint returns a flat array. Fixed api.ts to return EPGData[] and App.tsx to use the array directly.

title: Add Get from EPG button for TVG-ID field
description: Added a 'Get from EPG' button next to the TVG-ID input field in the Edit Channel modal. Clicking it opens a searchable dropdown that allows users to search EPG data entries and automatically populate the TVG-ID field with the selected entry's tvg_id value.

title: Fix Stream Profile endpoint path
description: Changed backend endpoint from /api/stream_profiles/ to /api/core/streamprofiles/ to match Dispatcharr API. The Stream Profile dropdown in the Edit Channel modal now properly shows all available profiles (ffmpeg, Proxy, Redirect, streamlink, etc.).

title: Fix EPG Data endpoint path
description: Changed backend endpoint from /api/epg/data/ to /api/epg/epgdata/ to match Dispatcharr API. The EPG Data dropdown in the Edit Channel modal now properly fetches and displays EPG entries.

title: Streams pane dropdowns should match Channels pane style
description: The Providers and Groups dropdown filters in the Streams pane should have the same styling and behavior as the Groups dropdown in the Channels pane (consistent UI/UX across panes).
close_reason: Fixed: Streams pane now uses multi-select checkbox dropdowns for Providers and Groups filters, matching the Channels pane style.

title: Logo modal should only open in Edit Mode
description: Currently clicking on a channel's logo opens the logo selection modal even when not in Edit Mode. The logo should only be clickable/editable when Edit Mode is enabled, similar to how other editing operations are gated.
close_reason: Fixed: Logo modal now only opens when Edit Mode is enabled. Added isEditMode check and updated CSS to remove hover effects when not editable.

title: Stream profile assignment for channels
description:
Add ability to set stream profile on channels. Features:
- Channel model has stream_profile_id field (integer, nullable)
- Option to use default profile (null/unset)
- Dropdown to select from available stream profiles (/api/stream_profiles/)
- StreamProfile model has: id, name, command, parameters, is_active, locked
- Show current profile name in channel edit view
- Profile determines how streams are processed/transcoded

title: Gracenote Station ID for channels
description:
Add ability to set Gracenote Station ID on channels. Features:
- Channel model has tvc_guide_stationid field (string, max 255 chars, nullable)
- Numeric integer entry field for station ID
- Used for TVC/Gracenote guide matching
- Show current station ID in channel edit view

title: TVG-ID assignment for channels
description:
Add ability to set TVG-ID on channels. Features:
- Channel model has tvg_id field (string, max 255 chars, nullable)
- Manual text entry for tvg_id
- Option to auto-assign tvg_id from EPG data (EPGData has tvg_id field) if an EPG is assigned
- Show current tvg_id in channel edit view
- TVG-ID is used for EPG program matching

title: Assign EPG source to channel
description:
Add ability to assign an EPG source to a channel. Features:
- Edit channel to select from available EPG sources (/api/epg/sources/)
- Channel model has epg_data_id field (integer, nullable) referencing EPGData
- EPGData has epg_source field linking to EPGSource
